skill.name: lead-research-assistant
skill.description: Researches and qualifies potential sales leads by analyzing a product, defining an ideal customer profile, and suggesting outreach strategies.
skill.summary: Finds and prioritizes B2B leads with fit scores, target roles, and outreach angles.
skill.author: DYAI2025

content.value_statement: Sales teams often lose time researching accounts that do not match their market. This skill builds focused lead lists with fit scores and outreach guidance.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes a product description or repository context to infer value propositions.
Defines an ideal customer profile using industry, size, location, pain points, and technology needs.
Searches for target companies that match the stated customer profile.
Scores leads from 1 to 10 based on fit, need signals, budget, and timing.
Suggests target roles, LinkedIn URLs when available, and personalized outreach angles.
Formats results as a prioritized lead research summary.
limitations: Results depend on public information and the browsing tools available to the host agent.
It cannot verify private contact details without user-provided sources.
Lead scores are heuristic and should be reviewed before sales action.
Users must follow privacy, anti-spam, and platform terms when using contact data.

use_cases.title: Launch First Prospect List
use_cases.description: Find early B2B prospects for a new product using a simple product description and target market.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Target Accounts
use_cases.description: Rank companies by fit, urgency, budget signals, and likely decision-maker roles.

use_cases.title: Plan Partnership Outreach
use_cases.description: Identify companies with complementary products and prepare tailored conversation starters.

prompt_templates.title: Find Starter Leads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with a product and target market.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 companies in [industry] that may need [product]. Include fit reasons, priority score, target role, and outreach angle.

prompt_templates.title: Research From Repository
prompt_templates.scenario: Use local product context to improve lead quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository to understand the product. Then find 10 likely B2B leads in [market] and explain the fit for each.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Defined ICP
prompt_templates.scenario: Provide detailed customer criteria for a narrower search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this ideal customer profile: [industry], [company size], [location], [pain points], and [technology stack]. Find 20 qualified leads.

prompt_templates.title: Build Account Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for scoring and outreach planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rank 20 target accounts for [product]. Include evidence, score, buying trigger, target role, value proposition, and first outreach message angle.

output_examples.input: Find leads for a security tool that masks sensitive data in AI coding prompts.
output: Summary: 12 leads found across fintech, legal, and healthcare software.
Top lead: A compliance-heavy SaaS company using AI developer tools, score 9 out of 10.
Recommended target role: VP of Engineering or Security Engineering Manager.
Outreach angle: reduce accidental customer data exposure during AI-assisted development.

output_examples.input: Find Bay Area companies that recently adopted remote work and may need productivity consulting.
output: Summary: 10 companies matched remote hiring and team growth signals.
Highest priority accounts show active distributed hiring and new operations roles.
Suggested target role: Head of People, COO, or Director of Operations.
Next step: verify recent remote policy sources before outreach.

output_examples.input: Use my ICP to find partner prospects for a developer analytics platform.
output: Summary: 15 partner prospects matched developer tooling and analytics needs.
Best-fit accounts have overlapping users and visible integration ecosystems.
Suggested approach: lead with shared customer workflow benefits.
Follow-up research should confirm partnership contacts and integration priorities.

best_practices: Provide a clear product description, target market, location, and company size range.
Ask for public-source reasoning for every lead before adding it to a CRM.
Review privacy and outreach rules before using personal or LinkedIn information.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for private contact data or scraped personal details.
Do not treat lead scores as verified purchase intent.
Do not send automated outreach without human review and compliance checks.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the product, target market, preferred geography, company size, and any known customer pain points.

faq.question: Can it analyze my repository?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can use repository context to infer the product, features, and likely customer value.

faq.question: Does it verify contact details?
faq.answer: It can suggest public roles and available LinkedIn URLs, but users should verify details before outreach.

faq.question: How are lead scores created?
faq.answer: Scores are based on fit, need signals, budget indicators, timing, and relevance to the ideal customer profile.

faq.question: Is this only for sales teams?
faq.answer: No. Founders, marketers, recruiters, and partnership teams can use it for account research.

faq.question: Can it create outreach messages?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can suggest personalized angles and conversation starters for each qualified account.
